{{Quote|Congratulations, Governor Graeber. You have the honor of being the first Core World leader to welcome the New Republic to its soil!|[[Jerell]], to [[Dennix Graeber]]|<ref name="Heroes & Rogues">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>}}
The '''liberation''' of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] occurred in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], several days before the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brentaal IV]]. A [[Ralltiir underground|resistance group]], including [[Bettle]] and [[Jerell]] managed to knock out the planetary shields, allowing a fleet of six [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] to attack the planet. [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] was the first [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] to be liberated by the New Republic.
